text:
rachel: Post-launch snapshot — site traffic +48% last 24h but MQL conversion dropped to 1.2% (was 2.4%). Digging into dashboard now. Posting quick gfx.

analytics-bot: [Automated] Dashboard refresh complete: sessions 24h +48%, conversions (MQL) 1.2% (-50% vs baseline). Top sources: organic, direct. Flags: campaign param drop on /launch landing paths.

sam: Checked inbound routing — last infra deploy yesterday touched the redirect service. @diego can you confirm the GA4 campaign param mapping wasn't modified?

diego: I rolled a redirect change for the shortener yesterday to reduce latency. It was a 301 at edge. Shouldn't drop querystrings but some proxies strip them. Will scan the edge logs. Quick query I ran: `SELECT campaign, COUNT(*) FROM pageviews WHERE path LIKE '/launch%' GROUP BY campaign ORDER BY COUNT DESC LIMIT 20;`

leah: Also seeing an uptick in low-quality webinar signups — higher bounce and lower email deliverability. Could be the form validation or the UTM-less fills. @rachel can you share a few sample lead IDs so we can trace?

rachel: dropping sample IDs: L-10023, L-10045, L-10067 — all landed from EMEA windows browsers, source=organic, campaign=(not set). Looks like UTMs dropped before tracker fired.

sam: Hypothesis: 301 redirect at edge stripped `?utm_*` for some user agents. If true, switching to 302 (preserve query) should help. @diego any chance to swap to 302 as quick mitigation?

diego: Will push a 302-preserve-query change in 10m to the shortener config. If infra approves. Patching now, will monitor. :construction_worker:

analytics-bot: Backfill job queued for campaign attribution (job_id:6721). Running incremental attribution re-processing for last 48h. ETA ~30m. Will post diff once complete.

rachel: Thanks. For the weekly KPI review, I want a short note in the pulseboard: "Attribution drift post-launch — temporary 301 redirect caused UTM loss; mitigation in flight; recommend short-term backfill + retarget low-quality signups." I'll add a one-slide action plan.

sam: Ack — adding to Friday KPI huddle agenda. Also noting impact window and expected recovery timeline. cc @leah for messaging follow-ups.

leah: I'll prepare a lean A/B for webinar follow-ups (cleaner CTA + stricter form validation) and a short copy variant for EMEA channels. Will drop the creative in #marketing-assets by EOD.

rachel: Perfect — appreciate the quick triage. Will monitor analytics-bot diff and update the pulseboard once backfill finishes.
